files.john-basketball-team.md:
---
name: john-basketball-team
description: John is a pro basketball shooting guard with the Minnesota Wolves (signed May 2023); career-high 40 points in July 2023; background, goals (championship, charity), teammates' signed ball, team trip plans, season won a trophy (Oct 2023), mentoring younger players (Oct 2023), injured and off the court (Nov 2023), rehab progress: jogged pain-free 15 Dec 2023, past ankle injury and resilience, pro for just under a year (Dec 2023), recent win over a top team and team bonding (Dec 2023), career-high assists vs rival (8 Dec 2023), buzzer-beater memory
type: user
---
John signed with the Minnesota Wolves (as of 21 May 2023) and plays shooting guard. Season opener was about 28 May 2023. His goal is to improve his shooting percentage. Fitting into the new team's style was a pre-season challenge, but things went well. Around 9 July 2023 he scored a career-high 40 points in a tough team win, then celebrated with teammates at a restaurant. He describes teammates as a second family. He has a game in Seattle in August 2023 and loves the city (energy, diversity, local seafood, fan support).

As of 9 August 2023: about 2 Aug 2023 he played an intense game the team won by a tight score, and he scored the last basket as the crowd cheered. He says teammates push him to improve, encourage him when he's down (in sport and life), and they hang out a lot.

Background (shared 11 Aug 2023): he grew up watching NBA games with his dad; at age 10 his dad signed him up for a local league. He played through middle and high school, earned a college scholarship, and was drafted after college. He has lucky basketball shoes he's had since the beginning, symbolizing resilience and determination. Main career goal: win a championship. He also recently took a trip to Chicago (early Aug 2023) and loved the energy and friendly locals.

As of 17 Aug 2023: he rejoined teammates on 15 Aug 2023 after his trip and got a warm welcome. Teammates gave him a basketball they all signed, as a sign of friendship; it reminds him why he started playing and motivates him.

As of 21 Sep 2023: around mid-Sep 2023 he went to a local restaurant with some new teammates and bonded over basketball. The team is planning a team trip in October 2023 to a new city, destination undecided (Tim suggested Edinburgh, which John liked; he's never been). He loves pro ball for the challenge, growth, teammates and fans. Goals: better shooting, being a consistent performer. Off court: seeking more endorsements, building his brand, thinking about life after basketball (maybe starting a foundation and charity work, leaving a legacy).

As of 13 Oct 2023: John described the season as intense, with tough losses and great wins, but overall the team did well, and they won a trophy. He said he needs new shoes after all the games.

As of 17 Oct 2023: John is mentoring the younger players on his team (off-season). He finds it rewarding, though challenging since everyone is different; some see him as a mentor and he enjoys being a positive role model on and off the court.

As of 16 Nov 2023: John has an injury and has had a tough week; the doctor said it's not too serious. He is staying positive and hates not being on the court. He uses visualizing goals and success to stay motivated.

As of 21 Nov 2023: still injured, taking recovery slowly and staying positive. He shared that last season he hurt his ankle, needed time off and physical therapy, and it taught him patience and perseverance. He also once messed up in a big game and learned to own mistakes and grow. His approach to setbacks: reflect on what went wrong, improve, and remember his love for basketball.

As of 6 Dec 2023: John has played professionally for just under a year and says it's living up to expectations (challenges, growth). He is improving his overall game, has landed endorsement deals and is learning to market himself and build his brand. His teammates come from all over the world. His advice on motivating teammates: show care, celebrate achievements, give constructive feedback, remind them of the bigger goal, keep a positive environment, pre-game pep talks.

As of 8 Dec 2023: the team recently beat a top team in a tough game. John says the best part was the camaraderie built on and off the court. To keep team bond strong they do team dinners, outings and games.

As of 11 Dec 2023: John had a career-high in assists on Friday 8 Dec 2023 in a big game against a rival (likely the same win noted above); he loves creating opportunities for teammates. His favorite career moment: down 10 in the 4th, he hit a buzzer-beater to win. As a kid he practiced outside for hours, using basketball to deal with doubts and stress.

As of 16 Dec 2023: John's team won a close game the previous week (likely the same 8 Dec win). He missed some games due to his injury and is doing daily physical therapy rehab, which is going well. On Friday 15 Dec 2023 he jogged a bit pain-free at the gym, a milestone; he and his wife hosted a small get-together with friends and family to celebrate.
files.john-interests.md:
---
name: john-interests
description: John's non-basketball interests: sneakers, jerseys, LeBron fan, Harry Potter (trivia, places, owns all movies), surfing, hiking club, travel (NYC, Italy Dec 2023, Paris, recommends Barcelona), languages (German, learning Spanish), cooking (honey garlic chicken), castles, inspirational reading, personal-development non-fiction, fantasy series, Lord of the Rings (Aragorn fan), currently reading Dune (Dec 2023), book recs from Tim, nature, camping (Rocky Mountains), movie fan, Tim's Ireland study abroad (Feb 2024)
type: user
---
John has a sneaker collection and loves talking about it. He hasn't been to any real Harry Potter places, but visiting them is on his to-do list. He owns the whole Harry Potter movie collection (as of 21 Aug 2023). He has surfed for about five years (started ~2018), loves the ocean and the connection to nature, and enjoys surfing with friends in summer.

As of 2 August 2023: he and his friend Anthony took part in a Harry Potter trivia contest at a charity event. John is reading an inspiring book that reminds him to keep dreaming, and he wants to keep reaching for new goals.

John chats regularly with a friend named Tim, who as of 2 August 2023 writes articles about fantasy novels (Harry Potter, Game of Thrones) for an online magazine. On 9 August 2023 Tim recommended a fantasy book by Patrick Rothfuss; on 11 August 2023 Tim named it as "The Name of the Wind" and John added it to his reading list. Tim also recently skyped with a Harry Potter fan he met in California and they talked about possibly collaborating. On 17 Aug 2023 Tim said he hopes to attend a book conference in September 2023; John said it would be awesome to go with him.

As of 21 Aug 2023, Tim is focused on school and reading fantasy books, and has started learning piano; his favorite piece is the Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone theme. Tim's family watches Home Alone, Elf and The Santa Clause at Thanksgiving/holidays, and Tim decorated a Harry Potter-themed Christmas tree. John's family gets together often.

As of 26 Aug 2023: Tim is swamped with assignments and exams but trying to balance study with fantasy reading. John loves discovering new cities and recommends New York City (culture, food, restaurants); Tim added NYC to his travel list and will tell John when he goes. John visited home around 19 Aug 2023, catching up with family and old friends; he played with those friends on his high school team for four years. Tim has never been on a sports team.

As of 31 Aug 2023: John had some trouble with the subway on his NYC trip but someone helped explain it. He's been trying out cooking, e.g. improvised a soup with sage (no recipe). He hasn't been to Universal Studios but it's on his bucket list. Tim got turned down for a summer job, gave a class presentation on 30 Aug 2023, and plans his first Universal Studios trip (Harry Potter areas) in September 2023, and will report back to John.

As of 21 Sep 2023: John read and loved "The Alchemist" (about following your dreams) and has it on his bookshelf; Tim also likes it. Tim re-recommended the Patrick Rothfuss novel as travel reading. Tim suggested Edinburgh (Harry Potter-linked) for John's trip.

As of 2 Oct 2023: John collects jerseys. LeBron James is his favorite player (admires work ethic, leadership); he says he has met LeBron a few times and seen him play live. John recently joined a hiking club. Tim shared his bookshelf of favorite fantasy novels (his escape from reality).

As of 13 Oct 2023: Tim went to a Harry Potter conference in the UK about the week before (~early Oct 2023) and loved it. Tim recommended a pair of comfy shoes he bought online; John said he'd check them out.

As of 17 Oct 2023: Tim shared a photo from his Smoky Mountains trip (2022); John enjoys escaping the city noise for nature. Tim is doing well in school and balancing it with reading. John hasn't had much time to read but picked up a new book after talking with Tim and is enjoying it.

As of 21 Oct 2023: John is fascinated by historical architecture and has visiting UK castles on his bucket list (Tim read a castles book). Tim is writing a fantasy novel and is inspired by J.K. Rowling. John says cooking is therapy; he often makes honey garlic chicken with roasted veg, uses a slow cooker, and promised to write out the recipe and mail it to Tim. He keeps motivational quotes on a whiteboard for tough workouts and a plaque on his desk reminding him to believe in himself. He says teammates and family are his key support.

As of 11 Nov 2023: John just finished a fantasy series he loved (twists, great characters) and enjoys fantasy books/shows as a mental escape.

As of 21 Nov 2023: John says fantasy fuels his creativity; he also loves non-fiction on personal development and mindset. He recently reread "The Alchemist" and found it motivating. Tim is swamped with studies, had a setback writing a story based on his UK experiences, and likes growth/psychology books too.

As of 1 Dec 2023: John likes The Hobbit and has read other popular fantasy series; Tim reorganized his bookshelf. Tim passed a tough exam in late Nov 2023. John shared a photo of a tranquil forest near his hometown and a Rocky Mountains camping trip from 2022; he finds nature humbling and calming.

As of 6 Dec 2023: John loves learning about different cultures and meeting people from different backgrounds. Tim joined a travel club and is learning the violin (classical, also jazz and film scores) in addition to piano (about four months). John hopes to hear him play someday.

As of 8 Dec 2023: John is currently reading "Dune" by Frank Herbert (enjoys it, recommends it). Tim just went to a Harry Potter party (wore a Gryffindor scarf), just finished "A Dance with Dragons" and has read only the GoT series by George R. R. Martin; John hasn't read Martin's books but plans to check them out.

As of 26 Dec 2023: John is a movie fan who likes relaxing with movies and is a Harry Potter fan. Tim is reading a book of travelers' stories to plan a dream trip (visited a travel agency; Himalayas trek story inspired him), loves Lord of the Rings, and is excited for the "The Wheel of Time" TV series (due ~Jan 2024). John is looking for travel ideas.

As of 2 Jan 2024: John took a trip to Italy in Dec 2023 (loved food, history, architecture) and bought a book there that inspires his cooking. He has also been to Paris and loved the Eiffel Tower view. He knows a bit of German and is just starting Spanish (using a phone app), motivated by travel and opportunities. He is a huge Lord of the Rings fan; favorite character is Aragorn (leader, selfless, never gives up) and he has an Aragorn painting in his room as a reminder to be a leader. Tim joined a globetrotters group, is learning German (took French in high school), loves Star Wars and Harry Potter, and has a Middle-earth map. John says basketball remains his passion; he practices and trains every day.

As of 7 Jan 2024: Tim got into a study abroad program (news Fri 5 Jan 2024) and goes to Galway, Ireland for a semester starting ~Feb 2024 (arts, Irish music, nature, Cliffs of Moher). John said he could visit after his season and Tim said to let him know. Tim is currently reading "The Name of the Wind"; John again said he'd add it to his list.

As of 12 Jan 2024: Tim is researching visa requirements for places he wants to visit. John recommended Barcelona (culture, architecture, food, nearby beaches) and Tim added it to his travel list.

files.john-endorsements.md:
---
name: john-endorsements
description: John's endorsement deals: signed Nike, talks with Gatorade, likes Under Armour, outdoor gear company deal (~Dec 2023), beverage company deal (~early Jan 2024); also gives sports/marketing seminars (Dec 2023)
type: project
---
As of 16 July 2023, John has signed a Nike deal for a basketball shoe and gear. He is in talks with Gatorade about a potential sponsorship. He has always liked Under Armour and would love to work with them. He landed these via basketball-industry contacts and his marketing skills (networking). Earlier (15 June 2023) he was only exploring brands like Nike and Under Armour.

As of 19 Dec 2023: about the week of 11 Dec 2023 he got a deal with a renowned outdoor gear company (hiking and outdoor gear). The photoshoot went well, held in a forest.

As of 26 Dec 2023: John recently started giving seminars (week of ~18 Dec 2023) helping aspiring pro athletes with sports and marketing; they went very well and he enjoys sharing his knowledge.

As of 12 Jan 2024: about the week of 4 Jan 2024 John got an endorsement with a popular beverage company (company not named; possibly the Gatorade talks). He called it a dream come true and a sign his hard work and training paid off.
files.john-charity-work.md:
---
name: john-charity-work
description: John's charity work: partnering with local org helping disadvantaged kids (Aug 2023); youth sports and fair chances for underserved communities, hometown basketball camp (summer 2023), charity event speaking (Dec 2023), benefit basketball game (~Jan 2024)
type: project
---
As of 11 August 2023, John is teaming up with a local organization that helps disadvantaged kids with sports and school. He wants to use his platform to make a positive impact on the community and inspire others, and to give back since basketball has been good to him.

As of 26 Dec 2023: John uses his influence and resources to support youth sports and fight for fair chances in sports for underserved communities, collaborating with organizations to create opportunities for young athletes. He spoke at a charity event. A highlight was organizing a week-long basketball camp for kids in his hometown in summer 2023. He admires public figures who use their platform for causes (e.g. Emma Watson).

As of 7 Jan 2024: John held a benefit basketball game the previous week (~late Dec 2023 to early Jan 2024). It was a total success: lots of attendees, money raised for charity. He says basketball brings people together and creates a positive impact.
files.john-fitness-routine.md:
---
name: john-fitness-routine
description: John found a new gym (Aug 2023), balances basketball practice with strength training and rest; started yoga (as of 1 Dec 2023)
type: user
---
As of 21 August 2023, John found a new gym to stay on top of his basketball game; finding it was tough. He had to adapt and tweak his routine, and after trial and error settled on a schedule combining basketball work and strength training, with enough rest (listening to his body). He says strength training builds muscle and power, prevents injury, and improved his shooting accuracy, agility, speed, explosiveness and confidence.

As of 1 Dec 2023: John has been trying yoga for extra strength and flexibility. It has improved his strength, flexibility, focus and balance during workouts. He likes Warrior II (makes him feel strong) and a balance/stability pose he holds for 30-60 seconds.
files.john-personal-life.md:
---
name: john-personal-life
description: John got married (~late Sep 2023) to his girlfriend; joined a hiking club; wedding details; European vacation/coastal road trip with wife (~6 Nov 2023, back by 11 Nov)
type: user
---
As of 2 Oct 2023, John and his girlfriend had their wedding ceremony the previous week (about 25 Sep 2023), a smaller, intimate gathering in a greenhouse venue with safety protocols. Tim calls her his new wife. Highlights: seeing her walk down the aisle, and a candlelit first dance at a cozy restaurant. Friends from his hiking club (which he recently joined) attended.

As of 6 Nov 2023: John and his wife had just left for a short European vacation. Tim recommended visiting castles (John has UK castles on his bucket list).

As of 11 Nov 2023: the trip was a road trip along the European coastline with his wife. He loved the spectacular views and bonding, and found it a nice change from regular life. He finds nature humbling and values taking time for himself and balance.
